rows.text: reads dword `022C7FEC`; when it is 0 and `ecx` is non-zero, calls `0026D6D0` on `003588B0(dword 022C7FE0)` when that is non-null and re-reads `022C7FEC`; then, when the (re-read) dword is non-zero and differs from `ecx`, calls `0026D6D0` on `003588B0(that dword)` when non-null and then `00259800(0)`; on every path finally stores the incoming `ecx` at dword `022C7FEC`
